overview: Ax = b ka solution: unique, infinite ya none — rank of A aur augmented matrix [A|b] se decide hota hai. Homogeneous Ax = 0 ka non-trivial solution det(A) = 0 hone par.
whyItMatters: 17 PYQs, 1996-2026; parameter-based 'kitne values par infinite/no solution' recent saalon me common hai.
coreConcept: Rank test: rank(A) = rank([A|b]) = n => unique; rank(A) = rank([A|b]) < n => infinite; rank(A) < rank([A|b]) => no solution (n = number of unknowns).
hinglishExplanation: Row-reduce karke echelon form banao. Agar koi row 0 = non-zero jaisi aa jaye to inconsistent (no solution). Free variables jitne, utne parameters, yaani infinite solutions. Square system me unique solution tabhi jab det(A) != 0.
importantProperties: Homogeneous Ax=0 hamesha consistent; trivial solution x=0.
Homogeneous me non-trivial solution <=> rank(A) < n <=> det = 0 (square).
Homogeneous solution space ki dimension = n - rank(A).
m < n (kam equations) wala consistent system infinite solutions deta hai.
Ax=b ke do solutions ka difference Ax=0 ka solution hota hai.
keyPropertiesAndIdentities: Square A: det A != 0 <=> unique solution for every b.
Parameter ke saath: det = 0 par rank alag check karo.
commonPitfalls: Sirf det dekhkar 'no solution' bol dena (infinite bhi ho sakta hai).
Parameter ki special values miss karna.
standardTechniques: Parameter wale sawal me det = 0 se special values nikaalo, phir har case me consistency.
